title: Troailt as laghyn seyrey
description: Ten short, simple stories about travel and holidays, on the Isle of Man and abroad.

lessons.title: Yn meain shenn
lessons.summary: Joseph and his brother Thomas take an old train up the mountain to an old mine; the train is an hour late, and the mine is deep and dark.
lessons.text:
Ta Joseph Killip as y braar echey, Thomas, er laghyn seyrey. T'ad goll lesh y traen dys meain shenn er y slieau.

Ec y stashoon ayns Doolish, cha nel y traen ayn. “Ta'n traen anmagh jiu,” ta fer y stashoon gra. “Bee eh ayns shoh ayns un oor.”

“Un oor?” ta Thomas gra. Cha mie lesh fuirraghtyn. Ta'n braar echey gearey. “Ta traa ain,” ta Joseph gra. “T'ou er laghyn seyrey!”

Ta Joseph as Thomas goaill bee ayns thie bee beg. Eisht ta'n traen çheet. She traen shenn eh, as ta mooarane sleih er. Ta'n traen craa er y raad, as ta'n cappan ayns laue Thomas craa neesht.

Ta'n traen goll seose er y slieau. Heose er y slieau, ta'n speyr lheeah, as ta'n geay lajer.

Ec y veain, ta ben aeg soilshaghey yn boayl daue. “She meain feer shenn ee,” t'ee gra. “Va mooarane deiney gobbraghey ayns shoh son keead blein. Ta'n veain dowin: ta ny raaidyn eck goll sheese foddey fo'n thalloo.”

Ta Thomas jeeaghyn sheese ayns towl. Ta'n towl dowin as dorraghey. “Row ny deiney gobbraghey ayns y dorraghey?” t'eh gra.

“Va,” ta'n ven gra. “Va soilshey beg oc, as va'n obbyr trome. Va'n clagh lheeah as creoi.”

Eisht ta'n ven goaill ad sheese ayns y veain son lieh oor. Ta ny boallaghyn lheeah as fliugh. Tra t'ad çheet magh, ta'n grian heose 'sy speyr.

Ta Joseph as y braar echey goll erash lesh y traen. Cha nel y traen anmagh nish. Ta'n traen craa reesht, agh ta Thomas cadley.

Feyshtyn:
Row'n traen anmagh?
Va. Va'n traen un oor anmagh.
Vel y veain dowin?
Ta. Ta'n veain dowin, as ta'n towl dorraghey.
Row'n speyr lheeah heose er y slieau?
Va. Va'n speyr lheeah, as va'n geay lajer.
Row'n traen craa?
Va. Va'n traen shenn craa er y raad.

lessons.title: Sheese y coan
lessons.summary: On holiday in Scotland, Gwen walks down a wide glen by the river in rain and cold, crosses at a ford and reaches the estuary, where the waves are big.
lessons.text:
Ta Gwen Stowell er laghyn seyrey ayns Nalbin. T'ee cummal ayns thie beg ec mullagh coan feayn. Ta awin roie trooid y coan, veih ny sleityn dys yn inver ec y cheayn.

Ec toshiaght y laa, ta Gwen jeeaghyn magh. Ta sniaghtey er mullagh y slieau, as ta'n aer feayr. Ta Gwen goaill cooat, as t'ee goll magh.

T'ee goll sheese y coan rish yn awin. T'ee goll er broogh yn awin. Ta'n coan feayn, as ta'n awin feayn neesht. Ta ushagyn er y broogh, as ta kirree er y chronk.

Lurg tammylt, ta fliaghey çheet. Ta'n fliaghey trome, agh cha nel Gwen goll erash. Ta'n thalloo soo stiagh yn fliaghey, as ta'n raad bog. Ta ny lossreeyn soo stiagh yn ushtey.

Ec mean y coan, ta'n raad goll harrish yn awin. Cha nel droghad ayn: ta aah ayn. Ta'n ushtey ec yn aah injil, agh t'eh feer feayr. Ta Gwen goll harrish yn aah. Ta'n ushtey feayr er e cassyn, as t'ee gearey. Ta Gwen er y broogh elley nish.

Ec jerrey y laa, ta Gwen ec yn inver. Ta'n awin goll stiagh 'sy cheayn ayns shoh. Ta ny tonnyn mooar, as ta'n geay lajer. T'ee soie er clagh as jeeaghyn er ny tonnyn. Ta'n fliaghey er scuirr, as ta'n grian çheet magh. Ta'n sniaghtey er y slieau bane 'sy ghrian.

Feyshtyn:
Vel sniaghtey er y slieau?
Ta. Ta sniaghtey er mullagh y slieau, as ta'n aer feayr.
Vel droghad harrish yn awin?
Cha nel. Ta aah ayn, as ta Gwen goll harrish yn aah.
Vel y thalloo soo stiagh yn fliaghey?
Ta. Ta'n thalloo soo stiagh yn fliaghey.
Vel ny tonnyn mooar ec yn inver?
Ta. Ta ny tonnyn mooar, as ta'n geay lajer.

lessons.title: Yn thie rish yn ammyr
lessons.summary: Bethany visits her Dutch friend Sanne, who lives on the third floor of a house by a canal; they eat at a table by the window and take a boat along the canals.
lessons.text:
Ta Bethany Cosnahan goll dys yn ard-valley Ollanagh son jeih laa. Va ben Ollanagh, Sanne, cummal ayns Doolish son jeih bleeaney, agh t'ee cummal 'sy çheer eck hene nish.

Ta thie Sanne er straid veg rish ammyr. Ta ammyryn ayns dagh straid 'sy valley, as ta baatyn beggey er yn ushtey. Ta Sanne cummal er y treeoo laare. Ta'n laare shenn, as t'ee craa tra ta Bethany goll er.

Ta'n jees oc soie ec y boayrd 'sy çhamyr. Ta bee Ollanagh er y voayrd: arran, caashey as eeast. “S'mie lhiam y bee Ollanagh,” ta Bethany gra.

“T'eh aashagh goll mygeayrt 'sy çheer shoh,” ta Sanne gra. “Ta'n thalloo injil, as cha nel slieau ayn. T'eh aashagh goll er y raad as er yn ushtey.”

Lurg y bee, ta'n jees oc goll magh. T'ad goll er baatey ayns yn ammyr. Ta soiag er y vaatey son dagh peiagh. Ta Bethany soie er y soiag eck, as t'ee jeeaghyn er ny thieyn. Ta ny thieyn ard as shenn, as ta blaaghyn rish ny dorryssyn.

“Vel yn ammyr shoh dowin?” ta Bethany gra.

“Cha nel,” ta Sanne gra. “Agh ta ammyryn elley dowin as feayn.”

Ec jerrey y laa, t'ad goll erash dys y thie. T'ad goll seose dys y treeoo laare, as t'ad soie ec y boayrd reesht. “Ta jeih laa giare,” ta Bethany gra. “Ta mee laccal çheet reesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Sanne cummal er y treeoo laare?
Ta. Ta Sanne cummal er y treeoo laare, ayns thie rish ammyr.
Vel bee Ollanagh er y voayrd?
Ta. Ta arran, caashey as eeast er y voayrd.
Vel soiag er y vaatey son dagh peiagh?
Ta. Ta soiag son dagh peiagh, as ta Bethany soie er y soiag eck.
Vel eh aashagh goll mygeayrt 'sy çheer?
Ta. Ta'n thalloo injil, as t'eh aashagh goll mygeayrt.

lessons.title: Yn poosey 'sy vannishter
lessons.summary: Iris's sister Stella marries in an old abbey in England; the organ plays, a poet reads a new poem and gets much praise, and Iris remembers playing weddings with her sister as children.
lessons.text:
Ta shuyr Iris Fargher, Stella, poosey jiu. Ta'n poosey ayns mannishter shenn ayns Sostyn. Ta'n mannishter mooar as shenn: v'eh troggit roish shey keead blein.

Ta Iris as e moir goll stiagh 'sy vannishter. Ta crosh vooar er y voalley, as ta soilshey çheet stiagh er y chrosh. Ta moir Iris ben chrauee. T'ee jeeaghyn er y chrosh, as t'ee cur ooashley da Jee.

Eisht ta'n organe cloie. Ta Stella çheet stiagh ayns gooyn bane. Ta Gavin, y fer t'ee poosey, shassoo ec y chrosh. Ta fer crauee loayrt roo, as t'ad gra “Ta” y jees oc.

Lurg shen, ta bard shassoo seose. She bard veih Sostyn eh. Ta'n bard lhaih daan noa mychione graih. Ta dagh peiagh jeeaghyn er y vard. Tra ta'n daan ec y jerrey, ta mooarane moylley ec y vard. “Daan feer vie,” ta moir Iris gra. Ta'n bard gearey. “S'mie lhiam y moylley,” t'eh gra.

Ta'n organe cloie reesht, as ta Stella as Gavin goll magh ass y vannishter.

Ec y feaill, ta Iris soie marish e shuyr. “Vel oo cooinaghtyn?” ta Iris gra. “Tra va shin aeg, va shin cloie poosey 'sy gharey. Va mee yn fer crauee, as v'ou yn ven noa.”

“Ta mee cooinaghtyn,” ta Stella gra, as t'ee gearey. “Agh cha row poosey rieau cho mie as y poosey shoh.”

“Cha row,” ta Iris gra. “Cha row mee rieau ec poosey cho aalin.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel y poosey ayns mannishter?
Ta. Ta'n poosey ayns mannishter shenn ayns Sostyn.
Vel crosh er y voalley?
Ta. Ta crosh vooar er y voalley.
Ren y bard lhaih daan?
Ren. Ren y bard lhaih daan noa, as va mooarane moylley echey.
Vel Stella cooinaghtyn er y gharey?
Ta. Ta Stella cooinaghtyn tra va ad cloie poosey 'sy gharey.

lessons.title: Yn boalley shenn
lessons.summary: Edward and his daughter Maya walk along the old Roman wall in the north of England; at the top of a hill he tells her how soldiers built it and kept watch there.
lessons.text:
Ta Edward Kewin as e inneen, Maya, er laghyn seyrey 'sy twoaie jeh Sostyn. T'ad goll rish boalley shenn. Ren impir veih Raue y boalley shoh y hroggal roish 1,900 blein.

Ta'n boalley foddey: t'eh goll veih'n cheayn sheear dys y cheayn shiar. Ta ymmodee ynnydyn shendeeagh rish y boalley. Ta Edward cur lioar da Maya mychione y troggalys.

“Va'n troggalys feer trome,” ta Edward gra. “Ren ny sidooryn yn obbyr. Va'n impir laccal boalley eddyr y çheer echey as ny sleih 'sy twoaie.”

Ta Edward as Maya goll seose dys baare cronk. Er baare y chronk, ta shenn thie sidooryn. “Ayns shoh, va ny sidooryn freayll arrey,” ta Edward gra. “Va sidoor ayns shoh oie as laa, freayll arrey er y twoaie.”

Ayns thie beg rish y boayl shendeeagh, ta craueyn shenn. Ta craue laue sidoor ayn, as craueyn kirree. “Va ny sidooryn gee feill kirree,” ta Maya gra.

“Cre'n fa ta'n boalley foast ayn?” ta Maya gra.

“Va'n troggalys lajer as beayn,” ta Edward gra. “Va sidooryn ayns shoh derrey'n trass eash, as ny s'anmey. Hie yn impir, agh ta'n boalley beayn. T'eh ayn jiu foast.”

Ta Maya shassoo er baare y chronk. T'ee jeeaghyn er y voalley lheeah goll foddey harrish y thalloo.

Feyshtyn:
Ren impir y boalley y hroggal?
Ren. Ren impir veih Raue y boalley y hroggal.
Row ny sidooryn freayll arrey?
Va. Va ny sidooryn freayll arrey er baare y chronk.
Vel craueyn ayns y thie beg?
Ta. Ta craueyn shenn ayns y thie beg.
Vel y boalley beayn?
Ta. Ta'n boalley beayn: va sidooryn ayn derrey'n trass eash, as t'eh ayn jiu foast.

lessons.title: Ny h-ellanyn 'sy twoaie
lessons.summary: Nina, a scientist, visits a group of small islands north of Scotland with a student for a project on their environment; they study a plant with toothed leaves and a bird with a long tail.
lessons.text:
Ta Nina Kinry gobbraghey ayns sheanse. T'ee goll dys ellanragh 'sy twoaie jeh Nalbin. Ta mysh feed ellan 'syn ellanragh, as ta ny ellanyn beg.

Ta shalee ec Nina: t'ee jannoo studeyrys er çhymbyllaght ny h-ellanyn. Ta'n shalee mychione ushagyn as lossreeyn. Ta studeyr aeg, Kai, marish. S'mie lesh Kai sheanse.

Ta'n geay feer lajer er ny h-ellanyn. “Ta forse mooar ec y gheay ayns shoh,” ta Nina gra. “Ta'n forse shen cur cummey er y çhymbyllaght: cha nel biljyn ard ayn.”

Ta Nina cur tastey da ny lossreeyn. “Cur tastey da'n lus shoh,” t'ee gra rish Kai. “Ta duillagyn feeacklagh echey. Jeeagh er oirr ny duillag: t'ee feeacklagh myr skian.”

Ta Nina goaill sheel veih'n lus. “Ta'n sheel shoh scanshoil son y shalee,” t'ee gra. “Ver mee yn sheel dys y scoill aym, as nee'n sheel gaase ayns shen.”

Eisht t'ad fakin ushag veg lesh famman liauyr. Ta'n ushag craa yn famman eck. “Cur tastey da'n famman,” ta Nina gra. “Ta'n famman liauyr cooie son y gheay.”

Ec jerrey y laa, ta Kai screeu ayns e lioar. “Ta'n ellanragh shoh mie son sheanse,” t'eh gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel ellanragh 'sy twoaie jeh Nalbin?
Ta. Ta mysh feed ellan 'syn ellanragh.
Vel forse mooar ec y gheay er ny h-ellanyn?
Ta. Ta forse mooar ec y gheay, as cha nel biljyn ard ayn.
Vel duillagyn feeacklagh ec y lus?
Ta. Ta duillagyn feeacklagh ec y lus.
Ren Nina goaill sheel veih'n lus?
Ren. Ren ee goaill sheel son y shalee.

lessons.title: Yn çhengoayllee 'sy vunscoill
lessons.summary: Hugo, a linguist on holiday on the Isle of Man, visits a primary school that teaches in Manx; the pupils read a text, answer his question and laugh kindly at his attempt to read it.
lessons.text:
She çhengoayllee eh Hugo Laurent. Ta çhengoayllee jannoo studeyrys er çhengaghyn. T'eh er laghyn seyrey ayns Ellan Vannin, as t'eh laccal fakin aavioghey y Ghaelg. Va'n Ghaelg bunnys marroo, agh nish ta paitçhyn loayrt ee reesht.

Ta Hugo goll dys bunscoill ayns balley beg. Ta'n vunscoill shoh ayn neayr's 2001, as ta ny paitçhyn ynsaghey ayns Gaelg. Neayr's shen, ta'n vunscoill er ve cooid scanshoil jeh'n aavioghey.

Ta'n ynseyder, Kerry Mylvorrey, goaill Hugo stiagh 'sy rang. Ta feed scollag 'sy rang. Ta dagh scollag lhaih teks beg ayns Gaelg. Ta'n teks mychione ushag as y famman eck.

Ta Hugo clashtyn fockle noa. “Cre'n keeal t'ec y fockle shen?” t'eh gra.

Ta scollag aeg cur freggyrt: “She ‘ushag veg’ y keeal.” Ta'n freggyrt kiart, as ta'n scollag gearey.

Eisht ta Hugo jannoo eab dy lhaih yn teks. T'eh lhaih dy moal, as ta ny scollagyn gearey. Agh t'ad cur cooney da. “Cha nel yn eab olk!” ta scollag gra. “Jean eab elley!”

Ta Hugo lhaih yn teks reesht. Ta'n eab shoh ny share.

Lurg y rang, ta Hugo loayrt rish Kerry. “Ta mee screeu mychione aavioghey çhengaghyn,” t'eh gra. “Ta mooarane çhengoaylleeyn credjal nagh vod çhengey çheet bio reesht. Agh shoh y freggyrt aym: ta'n aavioghey bio 'sy vunscoill shoh.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Hugo laccal fakin aavioghey y Ghaelg?
Ta. Ta Hugo laccal fakin aavioghey y Ghaelg.
Vel y vunscoill ayn neayr's 2001?
Ta. Ta'n vunscoill ayn neayr's 2001.
Ren scollag cur freggyrt?
Ren. Hug scollag aeg freggyrt kiart.
Ren Hugo eab dy lhaih yn teks?
Ren. Ren eh eab, as hug ny scollagyn cooney da.

lessons.title: Turrys dys Lunnin
lessons.summary: Old Victor, a socialist, takes his granddaughter Jasmine to London; they visit Parliament, argue about the economy, and he gives her advice for her future in politics.
lessons.text:
Ta Victor Cormode 80 bleeaney d'eash. She soshiallagh eh. Va'n ayr echey soshiallagh neesht.

Ta Victor goll dys Lunnin marish ben aeg y lught-thie, Jasmine. Ta Jasmine 17 bleeaney d'eash. T'ad goll er y traen.

Er y traen, ta fer y traen fogrey magh dy bee ad ayns Lunnin ayns lieh oor. Lurg tammylt, t'eh fogrey magh reesht: “Ta shin ayns Lunnin nish.”

Ta Lunnin feer vooar. “Ta ny smoo na hoght millioon dy leih cummal 'syn ard moirvaljagh,” ta Jasmine lhaih ayns e lioar. “Ta'n ard moirvaljagh shoh foddey ny smoo na Ellan Vannin!”

Ta'n jees oc goll dys y pharlamaid. “She reiltys deynlagh t'ayn,” ta Victor gra. “Ta dagh peiagh reih ny politickeyryn. Va'n sleih troddan son y reiltys deynlagh shoh.”

Er y raad erash, ta argane oc mychione y tarmaynys. “Ta'n tarmaynys lajer,” ta Jasmine gra.

“Cha nel dagh peiagh corrym,” ta Victor gra. “Ta argid mooar ec paart, as cha nel veg ec paart elley. Lhisagh dagh peiagh ve corrym.” Ta'n argane liauyr, agh ec y jerrey t'ad gearey.

“Cur dou coyrle,” ta Jasmine gra. “Ta mee laccal ve politickeyr.”

“Ta my choyrle aashagh,” ta Victor gra. “Bee firrinagh. Loayr dy firrinagh rish y sleih. Ta mee shickyr dy jean oo politickeyr mie.”

“Vel oo shickyr?” ta Jasmine gra.

“Ta mee shickyr,” ta Victor gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Victor soshiallagh?
Ta. She soshiallagh eh, as va'n ayr echey soshiallagh neesht.
Vel ard moirvaljagh Lunnin mooar?
Ta. Ta ny smoo na hoght millioon dy leih cummal 'syn ard moirvaljagh.
Vel argane oc mychione y tarmaynys?
Ta. Ta argane oc mychione y tarmaynys.
Vel dagh peiagh corrym, rere Victor?
Cha nel. Rere Victor, cha nel dagh peiagh corrym.

lessons.title: Yn feniagh 'sy valley
lessons.summary: Caitlin from Ramsey, whose great-great-grandfather was born in the west of Ireland, visits his village for the first time and learns that he was a hero who saved nine men from the sea.
lessons.text:
Ta Caitlin Gill cummal ayns Rhumsaa. Va shenn-shenn-ayr Caitlin ruggit ayns Nerin, as ta Caitlin jeh'n sliught echey. Cha row Caitlin rieau ayns Nerin.

'Sy tourey, ta Caitlin goll dys aarheynn 'sy sheear jeh Nerin. Ta'n aarheynn shoh feer aalin, lesh sleityn, loghyn as y keayn. Ta mooarane sleih 'syn aarheynn loayrt Yernish.

Va shelloo ec y shenn-shenn-ayr eck ayns shoh: thalloo beg as thie clagh. Ta Caitlin fakin y thie. Ta'n shelloo ec lught-thie elley nish, agh ta'n thie shenn foast ayn.

Ta Caitlin goll dys thie bee 'sy valley. Ta shenn dooinney, Declan, loayrt r'ee.

“Cre'n ennym t'ort?” t'eh gra.

“Caitlin Gill,” t'ee gra.

“Gill? Va'n ennym shen ec feniagh 'sy valley shoh!” ta Declan gra. “Ayns 1910, va nuy deiney ayns lhong er y cheayn, as va'n lhong goll sheese. Hie Gill magh 'sy cheayn ayns baatey beg, as hug eh ny nuy deiney gys y thalloo. She feniagh v'ayn.”

“Ta goo mie ec yn ennym Gill ayns shoh,” ta Declan gra. “Ta'n goo shen foast ayn.”

“Ta fuill y feniagh aym!” ta Caitlin gra, as t'ee gearey.

“Ta,” ta Declan gra. “Ta fuill Nerin ayd, as ta fuill Vannin ayd. Shoh dty valley neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Caitlin jeh sliught veih Nerin?
Ta. Ta Caitlin jeh sliught y shenn-shenn-ayr eck.
Row shelloo ec y shenn-shenn-ayr?
Va. Va thalloo beg as thie clagh echey.
Ren Gill cur nuy deiney gys y thalloo?
Ren. Hug eh ny nuy deiney gys y thalloo.
Vel goo mie ec yn ennym Gill?
Ta. Ta goo mie ec yn ennym Gill 'sy valley.

lessons.title: Heose 'syn aer
lessons.summary: Stuart books a holiday at a travel agency in Douglas, which confirms the trip from his account; on the plane he orders food, and the pilot explains the thin air and the pressure outside.
lessons.text:
Ta Stuart Corris goll er laghyn seyrey 'sy Spaainey. T'eh goll dys jantys ayns Doolish. Ta'n jantys reaghey laghyn seyrey ayns çheeraghyn elley.

“Ta feme ayd er argid ayns y choontys ayd,” ta'n ven ec y jantys gra. Ta Stuart jeeaghyn er y choontys echey. Ta argid dy liooar ayn.

“Ver mee lettyr dhyt dy hickyraghey yn turrys,” ta'n ven gra. Lurg daa laa, ta'n lettyr çheet: ta'n jantys er shickyraghey yn turrys.

Er y laa, ta Stuart as e vac, Jonah, ec y phurt aeragh hannah, roish y traa. Ta Jonah 9 bleeaney d'eash, as cha row eh rieau ayns etlan.

Heose 'syn aer, ta Stuart oardaghey bee as ushtey. Ta Jonah oardaghey bee neesht.

Eisht ta'n stiureyder loayrt. “Ta shin heose 'syn aeraght nish, foddey erskyn y cheayn,” t'eh gra.

Ta Jonah jeeaghyn magh, agh cha nel eh fakin y cheayn.

Ta'n stiureyder çheet magh as meenaghey yn aeraght da. “Ta'n aeraght thanney ayns shoh,” t'eh gra. “Ta'n broo injil mooie. Agh sthie 'syn etlan, ta'n broo mie, as ta aer dy liooar ain.”

Ta Jonah smooinaghtyn er ny t'eh meenaghey. “Ta mee toiggal,” t'eh gra. “Ta'n broo injil mooie, as mie sthie.”

Tra t'ad çheet sheese, ta'n grian soilshaghey. Ta Jonah gearey. “Ta shin ayns shoh hannah!” t'eh gra.

Feyshtyn:
Ren y jantys shickyraghey yn turrys?
Ren. Ta'n jantys er shickyraghey yn turrys.
Vel argid ayns y choontys ec Stuart?
Ta. Ta argid dy liooar ayns y choontys echey.
Ren Stuart oardaghey bee?
Ren. Ren eh oardaghey bee as ushtey.
Vel y broo injil mooie?
Ta. Ta'n aeraght thanney, as ta'n broo injil mooie.
